title: Text transformation
prompt: Convert `hello world` to uppercase. Answer only with the result.

title: Simple factual transformation
prompt: Answer only with the weekday immediately after Tuesday.

title: Linear equation
prompt: Solve 3(x - 4) = 2x + 7. Answer only with the value of x.

title: Without-replacement probability
prompt: A jar has 5 red, 4 blue, and 3 green balls. Two are drawn without replacement. Answer only with the simplified probability that both are red.

title: Bat and ball cognitive reflection
prompt: A bat and ball cost $1.10 total. The bat costs $1 more than the ball. Answer only with the ball's cost in dollars.

title: Monty Hall decision
prompt: In the standard Monty Hall problem, after the host opens a goat door, should the contestant stay or switch to maximize winning probability? Answer only with STAY or SWITCH.

title: Pair combinations
prompt: How many unordered pairs can be selected from 12 distinct items? Answer only with the number.

title: Syllogism validity
prompt: All bloops are razzies. Some razzies are lazzies. Does it follow that all bloops are lazzies? Answer only YES or NO.

title: Python aliasing behavior
prompt: What does this Python code print? `x = [1, 2]; y = x; x += [3]; print(y)`. Answer only with the printed list.
